scope_note: One row per canonical capability listed in docs/process/ledgers/capability-preflight-matrix.json's 15 entries (that matrix records what was PLANNED for the whole build; this ledger records what actually fired, or did not, specifically during slice 4). This ledger's most important epistemic move is in its 'actual_invocation_mechanism' field: this SDD workspace contains no tool-call transcript, so whether the Skill tool was literally invoked for any given capability is not established by anything available. This mirrors the exact evidentiary standard this build's own controller was held to at progress.md:1178.
